title: Harness quota diagnostics
description: Controller-owned, sanitized review evidence. This schema is internal to Harness review artifacts and Actions summaries; it is not a participant contract while it remains inside the control plane. Version 1 consumers ignore optional unknown properties.

schemaVersion.description: Semantic Versioning version in schema major 1. Minor versions may add optional properties; consumers ignore unknown properties and safe reason identifiers.

reasonCode.description: Primary safe stop reason. Additional same-major reason codes may be introduced additively.

stopPhase.description: Safe stop phase identifier. An unrecognized same-major value is displayed as unknown.

triggerReasons.description: Every known simultaneous safe cause, independently of the bounded bucket detail arrays.

windows.description: At most 32 triggering windows followed by at most 32 context windows.

triggeringWindows.description: A bounded sample of windows that caused the reserve stop or had invalid telemetry.

truncated.description: True when a record limit omitted quota bucket details or unsafe records were discarded. Trigger reason categories remain available.

nextEligibleAt.description: Unix time in seconds, present only when quota telemetry identifies an eligible reset and no other cause blocks execution.
